# Grand tourer vehicle asset

Car Concept by Eric Chadwick, Darmstadt Graphics Group GmbH (2024).
Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.
Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/CarConcept
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Original model by Unity Fan (CC0), as documented by the source repository.

Changes for Rokyta: baked scene transforms, centered and scaled to 4.42 m long
and 2.02 m wide including mirrors; front wheels aligned straight; three mesh
levels optimized with meshoptimizer; separately animated wheel and caliper
assemblies. Runtime uses eight paint palettes, neutral number plates, toned
interiors, filtered textures and efficient reflective transparent glazing.
Source geometry and texture attribution remain in the GLB asset metadata.
The source's Khronos and 3D Commerce marks belong to Khronos Group.

Original GLB SHA-256: c272098089d78c5cd9fd9f24ff50ee8acf8d932c55f2d55fc10adb6c8998966b
Prepared GLB SHA-256: 0c0fd590c752d765bed91dc677fef07ce8d054bb98fecadfcd6b384d7586a618

Close: 96,738 triangles. Medium: 30,163. Distant: 11,488.
All parked cars share geometry and textures. Detail selection has hysteresis.

The Three.js GLTFLoader, BufferGeometryUtils and SkeletonUtils files are from
Three.js 0.186.0, covered by ../THREE-LICENSE.txt.
